metadata.title: Empirical Finding: RAG Retrieval Augmentation Hallucination Mitigation [CONFIRMED]
metadata.abstract: Empirical testing of hypothesis 'RAG Retrieval Augmentation Hallucination Mitigation' across 3 random seeds. Outcome: CONFIRMED. Rationale: Hypothesis CONFIRMED across 3 seeds: Mean observed hallucination_rate = 0.1333 (std_err=0.0) satisfied threshold <= 0.2.

sections.Abstract: Empirical testing of hypothesis 'RAG Retrieval Augmentation Hallucination Mitigation' across 3 random seeds. Outcome: CONFIRMED. Rationale: Hypothesis CONFIRMED across 3 seeds: Mean observed hallucination_rate = 0.1333 (std_err=0.0) satisfied threshold <= 0.2.
sections.Hypothesis & Proposed Mechanism:
Statement: RAG grounding reduces factual hallucination by at least 50% relative to ungrounded generation across multi-seed evaluations.
Proposed Mechanism: Dense Context Retrieval Augmentation
Theoretical Rationale: Grounding queries in factual context passages constraints generative attention to reference tokens.
Baseline Method: Direct Generation without Retrieval
sections.Experimental Protocol:
Spec ID: spec-hyp-nlp-retr
Seeds Evaluated: [42, 101, 2024]
Valid Completed Runs: 3/3
